title: I run a cheer gym, can’t code, and shipped an iPhone game with Claude Code that uses your camera to time your handstand. Bet you can’t hold 3 seconds.
author: Friendly_Quarter_618
selftext:
I own a cheer and tumbling gym. I’m not a programmer: I’d never used git before this year. I built HitZero with Claude Code, and it’s live on the App Store now.

>**What it is:** prop your phone up and step back. Your body is the controller. There are 100+ camera games: tumbling skills, jumps (it measures how high you go), flying positions, shapes, and workouts that count your reps. The amount of body weight exercises could be its OWN fitness app on its own.  
>  
>**The one kids are obsessed with is Motions.** A cheer arm shape pops up (High V, T, Touchdown, Daggers…), an outline appears on your body on screen, and you have to snap your arms into it before it moves on. 30 seconds, 33 motions, 3 levels. You can’t just stand there. You have to really use your arms.



**How it’s built (the AI part):**

* Claude Code wrote basically all the code: a Next.js web app inside a small Swift iPhone shell.
* Pose tracking is Google’s MediaPipe, running on the phone. No video or data leaves the device.
* The 3D demos came from slow-motion videos we filmed at the gym, traced and cleaned up into animations.
* The coach voice is about 860 pre-made AI text-to-speech lines.
* Jump height comes from time in the air (h = g·t²/8). The phone only has to see your feet leave the floor and come back down.

**The hard parts weren’t the AI:** keeping the game locked on ONE kid when 10 are running around a gym, the pose model drawing a kid upside down mid-flip, working whether the phone is on the floor or on a shelf, and iOS pausing the camera every time the voice talked.

**The challenge.** Both of these games are free:

* **Handstand:** hold 3 seconds for 3 stars. Harder than it sounds.
* **Toe Touch:** the phone measures your jump in inches. 18 inches gets 3 stars.

Post your time or your inches below. Clear some space and use a soft floor.

iPhone / iPad: [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hitzero-cheer-tumbling/id6821221683](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hitzero-cheer-tumbling/id6821221683)

Happy to answer anything about the build.
